amended: 2026-10-10, review fixes, still before any RIO10 data: the update keyframe rule (kf_trans, kf_rot), labels_id_property, rscan_max_absent_share and the G3 precondition (plan section 6) were added; no threshold changed.
update_note: kf_trans [m] / kf_rot [deg]: scripts/run_mapping.py --kf-trans / --kf-rot (its defaults) of the field runs; the ground truth judges the update frames the field ingests (usplat.change_eval.select_keyframes), and eval refuses a field whose update stride, part or keyframe rule differs
gt_source_note: instances: RIO10 labels.ply instance ids of seqXX_01 vs seqXX_02 (V8 of usplat/datasets_rio.py unverified); 3rscan: removed/rigid/nonrigid of 3RScan.json with the scan-id map rio_to_3rscan
rscan_note: 3rscan route: share of the instance ids in the 3RScan lists that may be absent from the RIO10 labels.ply of seqXX_01 (V10 of usplat/datasets_rio.py); above it the ids are not one id space and gt-rio10 refuses
labels_id_property_note: labels.ply vertex property holding the instance id; null = the first of usplat.datasets_rio.ID_PROPERTIES (never 'label' / 'id', which may be class ids: V7). Both scans must use the same property
class_map_note: RIO10 label name -> configs/vocab_replica.json id for the segmentation pass-through (plan K12); empty until it is written on val 01 from label names only. Empty: the ground truth carries no targets and eval reports no segmentation block

visibility.depth_note: seqXX_02 rendered mesh depth: ground-truth side only (hidden / unobserved), never an input of a method row except the oracle row

rows.residual_filter_note: a residual row scores a Gaussian by the largest value of its k = 2 persistent residual over the update (paper, Metrics)

operating_point.note: baselines: one threshold per row from the static VALIDATION Gaussians (scripts/eval_change.py thresholds). Gaussian-level FA: the checkpoint stores no per-view residuals, so the paper's per-view 1e-3 rate is approximated by a Gaussian-level rate; ours uses its label-free fired flags

static_fa_val.statement: plan section 6, G3: the static false-alarm rate on Replica val is at most the NCC rate in every case: per-view false-alarm rate of the frozen static_fa config <= the NCC residual's, on every Replica val scene
static_fa_val.record: val_selection.json of scripts/replica_static_fa.sh STAGE=val (scripts/static_fa_report.py select, track T2), given as eval_change.py criterion --precondition static_fa_val=PATH

preconditions_note: G3 passes iff every precondition of the split passes AND the criteria pass by criteria_rule; a precondition without its record fails

g3_i.statement: Ours c has a higher Gaussian-level AP than every non-oracle residual (NCC, depth, feature) on >= 2 of 3 val scenes

g3_ii.statement: fusion (c + non-oracle depth) has a higher AP than non-oracle depth alone by >= 0.03 on >= 2 of 3 val scenes
